Parts.Description: A green garden with raked gravel courts, mossy patches and neat stone plazas.
Parts.Name: Shrine Grounds

Parts.Description: A tall vermilion pagoda with five curving tile roofs and a golden spire watches over the Samurai Shiba.
Parts.Name: Five-Storey Pagoda

Parts.Description: A tall red torii gate with a black crown beam stands over the walkway, welcoming every visitor.
Parts.Name: Vermilion Torii

Parts.Description: Three mossy stone toro of different heights, glowing softly beside the walkway.
Parts.Name: Stone Lantern Garden

Parts.Description: A little wooden tea house on a raised deck with a tiled roof, a blue curtain, a bench and a red parasol.
Parts.Name: Tea House

Parts.Description: Four tall banners of the clan, red, white and blue, snapping in the wind on tall poles.
Parts.Name: Nobori War Banners

Parts.Description: A winding pond of blue water ringed by mossy rocks, with water lilies and orange koi.
Parts.Name: Koi Pond

Parts.Description: A wide wooden dojo with a tiled roof, paper doors and straw dummies where the samurai train every day.
Parts.Name: Training Dojo

Parts.Description: A stone water basin under a small roof where visitors rinse their hands with a bamboo ladle.
Parts.Name: Purification Basin

Parts.Description: Three straw targets before an earth bank and a roofed line to loose long bows from. Bonk, thwack, bullseye!
Parts.Name: Kyudo Archery Range

Parts.Description: A high red bridge with curved rails that carries visitors over the koi pond.
Parts.Name: Arched Red Bridge

Parts.Description: Raked white gravel in calm waves around mossy rocks, a bonsai pine and a tiny lantern.
Parts.Name: Zen Rock Garden

Parts.Description: An old cherry tree in full bloom, with a carpet of fallen pink petals around its twisted trunk.
Parts.Name: Great Sakura Tree

Parts.Description: A huge taiko drum in a wooden cradle beside a small drum, ready to boom out the Bonk beat.
Parts.Name: Festival Taiko

Parts.Description: A tiled pavilion with a great bronze bell and a log striker that rings out over the whole shrine.
Parts.Name: Temple Bell Pavilion

Parts.Description: A full suit of red samurai armour with a golden crescent helmet, guarded on its little platform.
Parts.Name: Armour Stand

Parts.Description: The main hall: a stone terrace, red pillars, white walls and a mighty tiered roof with golden crossed finials.
Parts.Name: Great Shrine Hall

Parts.Description: A pair of stone komainu on pedestals, one with open mouth and one with closed, guarding the shrine hall.
Parts.Name: Guardian Lion-Dogs

Parts.Description: A little roofed rack hung with wooden ema plaques, each with a wish for a better Bonk.
Parts.Name: Wishing Plaque Rack

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a giant samurai in red armour and a crescent helmet leaning on his great sword.
Parts.Name: Colossal Samurai
